CONFIDENTIAL

S. B. REGISTRY
Special Branch S.S.D. 7508
REPORT
Date August 22, 1936.
Subject Miss A.V. Miller, Russian emigrant.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Payne C.S.I.
There seems to be some doubt as to the correct
name of Miss A.V. Miller, now residing at Apartment No. 59,
Broadway Mansions. She is registered there as Miss A.V.
Millar, at the offices of the Russian Emigrants' Committee
she is known and registered as Anna Vladimirovna Miller,
whilst at the Bureau of Public Safety, Nantao, where she is
registered as a White Russian, she gives her name as Anna
Ivanovna Miller. Various registration forms have been seen
and she describes herself in three different ways as above.
She was born at Harbin on July 7, 1909 and is of
British or German descent. She is of the Russian Ortho-
dox faith and a spinster.
Arriving in Shanghai on April 9, 1932 from Harbin
via Newchwang without documents, she applied on June 10, 1932
to the Bureau of Public Safety for a passport with which to
travel to Harbin and back. On the strength of:
(1) a letter dated June 10, 1932 issued by Mr. N.G. Fomin,
former President of the now defunct Russian National
Community of Shanghai, in which she is described as Mrs
A.I. Miller and a reliable person, and
(2) the passport application form in which she states that
her name is Anna Ivanovna Miller,
she was issued with Passport No. 1108 on June 20, 1932. At
this time Miss Miller was residing at 1196 Bubbling Well Road.
On June 28, 1935 she registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee as Miss Anna Vladimirovna Miller and
gave her address as Apartment 1a, Lincoln Apartments, 1562
Avenue Joffre. On June 29, 1935 she was issued with
Passport No. 11543 by the Bureau of Public Safety for a trip

报告
日期：1936年8月22日。
事由：A.V. 米勒小姐，俄国移民。
撰写人：D.S. Pitts。呈报人：J. Payne C.S.I.
目前居住在百老汇大厦59号公寓的 A.V. 米勒小姐，其正确姓名似乎存在一些疑点。她在该处的登记姓名为 A.V. Millar 小姐；在俄国侨民委员会的办事处，她为人所知并登记的姓名为 Anna Vladimirovna Miller（安娜·弗拉基米罗芙娜·米勒）；而在南市公共安全局，她作为白俄进行登记时，自称姓名为 Anna Ivanovna Miller（安娜·伊万诺芙娜·米勒）。已查阅各种登记表，她以上述三种不同方式描述自己。
她于1909年7月7日出生于哈尔滨，具有英国或德国血统。她信奉东正教，未婚。
她于1932年4月9日从哈尔滨经牛庄抵达上海，未持任何证件。1932年6月10日，她向公共安全局申请护照，以便往返哈尔滨。基于以下文件：
(1) 一封日期为1932年6月10日的信函，由现已解散的上海俄国国民公会前主席 N.G. Fomin 先生出具，信中称她为 A.I. Miller 夫人，并称其为可靠人士；以及
(2) 护照申请表，其中她声明其姓名为 Anna Ivanovna Miller，
她于1932年6月20日获发第1108号护照。当时，米勒小姐居住在静安寺路1196号。
1935年6月28日，她在俄国侨民委员会登记为 Anna Vladimirovna Miller 小姐，地址为霞飞路1562号林肯公寓1a室。1935年6月29日，公共安全局向她签发了第11543号护照，供其前往

to Harbin, whence she returned to Shanghai via Dairen on
September 11, 1935 by the s.s. "Dairen Maru" since when she
has been residing at Broadway Mansions.
        It is of interest to note that she occasionally
receives mail matter from Soviet Russia which are addressed
to Anna Vladimirovna Miller.
        An attractive looking woman 5'0" in height, blonde
hair, oval face, green eyes, straight nose, slim figure,
she has an excellent command of the English language, whilst
her manners leave nothing to be desired.    At present she
is the mistress of, and is kept by, an officer of the
Great Northern Telegraph Company's cable ship "Pacific."

                                            J.A. Pitts.
                                                D.    S.

哈尔滨旅行，此后她于1935年9月11日乘坐“大连丸”号轮船经大连返回上海，自此一直居住在百老汇大厦。
值得注意的是，她偶尔会收到寄给 Anna Vladimirovna Miller 的来自苏维埃俄罗斯的邮件。
她是一位外貌迷人的女性，身高5英尺0英寸，金发， oval 脸形，绿眼睛，直鼻梁，身材苗条，精通英语，举止得体。目前，她是北大电报公司电缆船“太平洋”号一名军官的情妇，并由该军官供养。

                                            J.A. Pitts.
                                                D.    S.
副总监（刑事及特别科）。

CONFIDENTIAL

We agree that each party during marriage shall
each be responsible only for his or her own support and
shall in no way be responsible for the support or
maintenance of one another. Neither party shall molest
or interfere in any way with the other party and each shall
lead his or her own separate life.

Signed

We mutually agree to get married at the earliest
possible date at the British Consulate in Shanghai, in
consideration of which Anna Miller pays to E.T. Maitland
the sum of $2,500 (Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars)
Shanghai Currency - and shall pay all the expenses of
marriage passports, registration.

Signed

我们同意，在婚姻存续期间，各方仅负责各自的生活供养，绝不承担供养或扶养对方的责任。任何一方不得骚扰或以任何方式干涉另一方，各方应过各自独立的生活。

签名

我们相互同意尽早在上海英国领事馆结婚，鉴于此，Anna Miller 支付给 E.T. Maitland 上海银元2,500元（贰仟伍佰元整），并承担办理结婚护照及登记的所有费用。
